name: Weighted Rubric Jury with Critical-Error Override
description: Blueprint 21 of 96 (design card BP-CNC-06, 09-WORKFLOW-BLUEPRINT-LIBRARY.md:1091). MECHANISM: score an artifact on a rubric FIXED AND HASHED BEFORE the artifact is read, one call PER DIMENSION (the reliability protocol, expressed here as a fan-out with max_concurrency 1 so the calls are genuinely serialised and cannot cross-contaminate), then apply a CRITICAL-ERROR OVERRIDE where a critical dimension scoring zero CAPS the whole composite regardless of the other eight. A dimension that cannot be evidenced scores UNKNOWN and is EXCLUDED from the composite with the exclusion stated - never silently defaulted to mid-scale, which is how a fatal flaw averages its way to a pass. An optional cross-vendor critic is reconciled CONSERVATIVELY (take the lower score).

artifact.description: The artifact under score: a design, a plan, a report, a skill or a PR

rubric.description: The rubric. Fixed and hashed BEFORE the artifact is read - a rubric changed after seeing the artifact is invalid, because then the rubric is a justification rather than a standard.

artifact_class.description: Which canonical rubric applies. OWNER-DECISION on the design card: which classes get a canonical rubric and who owns its weights.

cross_vendor_critic.description: Add a cross-vendor critic as a 5th persona, reconciled conservatively (the LOWER of the two scores wins)

restability_check.description: Re-score the artifact a second time and require every dimension to move by at most one point, or the protocol is not stabilising

rubric-keeper.description: Fixes and hashes the rubric before the artifact is read; refuses any change to weights afterwards

metric-computer.description: Computes every deterministic metric BEFORE any scoring call, so a number is never left to model judgement when it can be measured

dimension-scorer.description: Scores exactly ONE dimension per call, citing evidence; sees no other dimension's score

codex-critic.description: Optional cross-vendor critic; its disagreement is reconciled conservatively rather than averaged

compositor.description: Applies the critical-error override and computes the weighted composite; excludes UNKNOWN dimensions and states the exclusion

owner.description: The human owner - owns each rubric's weights; a rubric invented ad hoc to justify a conclusion is the failure this ownership prevents

routes.reason: the critic must not share the scorer's blind spots
computing a deterministic metric needs correctness, not creativity

rubric-frozen-before-read.expression: rubric_hash_recorded == true AND artifact_bytes_read_at_freeze == 0 AND weights_changed_after_freeze == 0

unknown-excluded-not-defaulted.expression: dimensions_defaulted_to_midscale == 0 AND unknown_dimensions_excluded_and_stated == true AND scores_without_evidence == 0

stages.title: S0 FIX the rubric and weights BEFORE seeing the artifact, and hash them

work_unit.title: Freeze and hash the rubric before any artifact byte is read
work_unit.question_or_target: Write the rubric - dimensions, weights, critical flags, scale and critical cap - to disk and hash it, recording that zero artifact bytes have been read.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: rubric design is the whole ballgame; freezing it is cheap and non-negotiable

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the freeze records a sha256 over the rubric, the weight sum, and artifact_bytes_read == 0 at write time, so a rubric edited after the artifact was seen is mechanically detectable
tests_required: a rubric whose weights are changed after the freeze must FAIL the frozen gate
a rubric whose weights do not sum to 1 must be rejected at freeze time, not silently renormalised
both-states control: freeze AFTER reading the artifact and confirm the gate FAILS; freeze before and confirm it PASSES
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the compositor verifies the rubric hash used in the composite matches the frozen hash
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:WCNC-0601 emitted when rubric-freeze.json exists, parses, records the hash and artifact_bytes_read == 0, and the weights sum to 1; otherwise FAILED:WCNC-0601 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: no retry after the artifact has been read - restart the invocation with a clean rubric instead

stages.title: S0b A rubric changed after seeing the artifact is invalid
S1 COMPUTE every deterministic metric first - never ask a model for a number you can measure

work_unit.title: Compute the deterministic metrics named by the rubric before any scoring call
work_unit.question_or_target: For every dimension declaring a deterministic_metric, compute it with a rerunnable command and record the exact output.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: an exact algorithm beats LLM judgement on a mechanical comparison; measured 86% accuracy with 100% of errors in the dangerous direction

work_unit.evidence_requirement: each metric records the exact command and its raw output; a metric that could not be computed is recorded NOT-COMPUTED with the reason, never estimated
tests_required: a dimension declaring a deterministic_metric must not be scored by judgement when the metric computed successfully
both-states control: break one metric command and confirm it records NOT-COMPUTED rather than an estimated value
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the compositor re-runs one metric command and confirms the output matches
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:WCNC-0602 emitted when deterministic-metrics.json exists, parses, and every declared metric carries a command plus output or an explicit NOT-COMPUTED; otherwise FAILED:WCNC-0602 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: record NOT-COMPUTED and let the dimension fall through to judgement with that fact stated

stages.title: S2 SCORE one dimension PER CALL - serialised, each blind to the others

body.title: Score exactly one dimension, citing evidence

work_unit.title: Score one rubric dimension 0-4 with cited evidence, or UNKNOWN
work_unit.question_or_target: Score the assigned dimension only, on the 0-4 scale, citing the evidence for the score. If the dimension cannot be evidenced, return UNKNOWN - never a mid-scale guess.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: one call per dimension is the reliability protocol; batching dimensions is what makes scores drift

work_unit.evidence_requirement: every score cites a file:line, a screenshot region or a computed metric; a score with no evidence is rejected rather than accepted at face value
tests_required: a score with no cited evidence must fail the evidence check
an unevidenceable dimension must return UNKNOWN, never 2 of 4
both-states control: strip the evidence from one score and confirm scores_without_evidence rises above zero and the gate FAILS
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the optional cross-vendor critic re-scores independently; reconciliation takes the LOWER score, never the mean
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:WCNC-0603 emitted per dimension when the score artifact exists, parses, and carries a 0-4 score with evidence or an explicit UNKNOWN; otherwise FAILED:WCNC-0603 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: one retry with the scale restated inline; then record UNKNOWN rather than forcing a number

stages.title: S2b UNKNOWN is excluded and stated - never defaulted to mid-scale
S2c CONDITIONAL cross-vendor critic, reconciled CONSERVATIVELY (take the lower score)

work_unit.title: Cross-vendor re-score and conservative reconciliation
work_unit.question_or_target: Independently score the same dimensions on the same frozen rubric, then reconcile against the primary scores by taking the LOWER score per dimension.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: a same-vendor critic shares the scorer's blind spots, so the second opinion must cross vendors to be worth paying for

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the critic cites its own evidence per dimension and the reconciliation records both scores plus which one was taken - conservatism must be visible, not asserted
tests_required: reconciliation must take the LOWER score, never the mean - a mean re-introduces the averaging this blueprint exists to prevent
both-states control: feed a critic score of 1 against a primary of 4 and confirm the reconciled value is 1
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the compositor confirms every reconciled value equals the minimum of the two inputs
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:WCNC-0604 emitted when cross-vendor-scores.json exists, parses, and every reconciled value is the minimum of the pair; otherwise FAILED:WCNC-0604 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: one retry with --ignore-user-config on a win-arg-limit; no retry on a severed stream - proceed with the primary scores and record the critic as absent

stages.title: S3-S4 APPLY the critical-error override, then compute the weighted composite

work_unit.title: Apply the critical-error override and compute the capped weighted composite
work_unit.question_or_target: If any critical dimension scored zero, CAP the composite at the rubric critical_cap regardless of the other dimensions; otherwise compute the weighted composite over the evidenced dimensions only, restating which UNKNOWN dimensions were excluded.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: the override is the mechanism that stops a beautiful thing with a fatal flaw from averaging its way to a pass

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the verdict shows the arithmetic: per-dimension score, weight, contribution, the excluded UNKNOWN set, whether the cap fired and which critical dimension triggered it - the composite must be recomputable by hand from the artifact
tests_required: an artifact with one fatal flaw and eight strong dimensions MUST be capped, not averaged - the design card's decisive benchmark
an UNKNOWN dimension must be excluded from the denominator, not counted as mid-scale
re-score the same artifact twice - dimension scores must move at most one point or the protocol is not stabilising
both-states control: set one critical dimension to zero and confirm composite_capped == true; set it to 1 and confirm the cap does NOT fire
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: one independent reader recomputes the composite by hand from the published arithmetic and confirms it matches
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:WCNC-0605 emitted when verdict.json exists, parses, publishes the full arithmetic, and the cap state matches the critical scores; otherwise FAILED:WCNC-0605 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: publish the per-dimension scores with the composite marked UNCOMPUTABLE rather than a number that cannot be reproduced

stages.title: S4b A critical zero MUST cap the composite
S4c ADVISORY - if a re-score moves a dimension by more than one point the protocol is not stabilising

impact.blast_radius: read-only on the artifact plus writes under command-center/rubric/bp-cnc-06/**; the verdict is a score, not an action

x_extensions.distinct_mechanism: a hashed rubric frozen before the artifact is read, deterministic metrics computed before any judgement call, a fan-out with max_concurrency 1 so dimensions are scored strictly one per call, UNKNOWN excluded from the denominator rather than defaulted, a hard critical-error cap, and conservative (minimum, never mean) cross-vendor reconciliation
x_extensions.not_a_duplicate_because: BP-CNC-01 returns categorical persona verdicts and no score; this returns a weighted numeric composite with a hard cap - a different decision surface. It is the only blueprint in this range whose fan-out is deliberately serialised (max_concurrency 1) and the only one carrying an intentionally NON-blocking advisory gate alongside blocking ones.
contraindications: the dimensions are unknown - run a council first
a binary go/no-go - a composite is the wrong instrument
a rubric invented ad hoc to justify a conclusion the author already reached
conflicts_with: ad-hoc scoring without a pre-fixed rubric
x_extensions.owner_decision: OPEN (design card BP-CNC-06): which artifact classes get a canonical rubric (design, plan, skill, PR) and who owns each rubric's weights? artifact_class is a required enum param so the question is surfaced at every invocation rather than defaulted.

worked_examples.name: capping benchmark - eight strong dimensions and one fatal flaw

dimensions.name: control-plane-singularity
dimensions.deterministic_metric: count distinct physical schema roots referenced

dimensions.name: test-coverage-of-the-claim
dimensions.deterministic_metric: pytest -q collected count for the new module

worked_examples.walkthrough: S0 hashes the nine-dimension rubric (weights sum to 1.0) with artifact_bytes_read == 0. S0b passes. S1 computes two deterministic metrics: distinct physical schema roots == 3 and pytest collected == 475. S2 scores nine dimensions one call at a time, serialised. control-plane-singularity scores 0 because the plan introduces a second physical root - a CRITICAL dimension at zero. The other eight score 3 or 4. S2b passes (all evidenced, no UNKNOWN). S2c's cross-vendor critic scores reversibility 2 against the primary 3; reconciliation takes 2 (the lower). S3-S4 sees critical_zero_present and CAPS the composite at 1.0 instead of computing the weighted mean, which would have been about 3.0 - a comfortable pass. S4b passes. S4c re-scores and finds max drift 1, so the advisory records a stabilising protocol.

expected_gate_outcomes.rubric-frozen-before-read: PASS - hash recorded, artifact_bytes_read == 0, weights unchanged
expected_gate_outcomes.critical-override-applied: PASS - critical zero present AND composite_capped == true

worked_examples.name: negative control - a dimension that cannot be evidenced
worked_examples.expected_terminal_state: SUCCESS:WCNC-0605 with one dimension excluded as UNKNOWN
worked_examples.walkthrough: operator-satisfaction cannot be evidenced from a plan document - there is no operator and no measurement. The scorer returns UNKNOWN rather than 2 of 4. The composite is computed over the two evidenced dimensions with their weights RENORMALISED and the exclusion stated in the verdict. The failure this prevents: had UNKNOWN silently become mid-scale, a 30%-weighted invented number would have carried a real verdict. dimensions_defaulted_to_midscale must stay 0 for the evidence gate to pass, and a mutated run that defaults it FAILS - that is the both-states control for this arm.

benchmark_cases: an artifact with one fatal flaw and eight strong dimensions - the composite MUST be capped, not averaged
re-score the same artifact twice - dimension scores should move at most 1 point or the protocol is not stabilising
x_extensions.unverified: UNVERIFIED outside the UI domain: the override and weighted composite exist today only inside the ui-audit skill, while critique-panel and rubric-verifier have personas and lenses but no override. Settling experiment = score five plans, plant a fatal flaw in one, confirm the cap fires. Confidence that the override generalises: corpus band very-likely (80-90%), expressed in estimate.confidence as the nearest legal DSL band likely; that the stability protocol holds outside UI: likely (55-80%).
x_extensions.confidence_band_note: The DSL confidence_band enum has five members and no very-likely, so the corpus band very-likely (80-90%) is recorded here and estimate.confidence carries likely.
